Definition: from G4253 and G5348; to get an earlier start of, i.e. anticipate:--prevent.
BiblicalUsage: Prophthano means to get an earlier start, to anticipate, to prevent. Matthew uses it once: when Peter comes into the house, Jesus prevents him, asking first, What thinkest thou, Simon, of whom do the kings of the earth take custom?
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jesus always speaks first, and his question before Peter's is the proof that he knows what is in the heart.
